user.title: ISS Track
user.description: Add ISS Track? You get a live map panel in the sidebar, entities for the station's position, and predictions of the passes you can see from home.

data_description.unit_system: Altitude and speed are shown in this system by default. Switch anytime with the toggle on the map.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single instance is possible.

init.title: ISS Track
init.description: Pass settings decide which visible passes count. They are shared by the entities, the calendar, the map panel and the dashboard card.

data.weather_entity: Weather entity for the sky forecast
data.people: Also predict passes for these people

data_description.unit_system: Altitude and speed on the map are shown in this system by default.
data_description.qualities: Judged on the highest point reached while the station is visible.
data_description.faintest_magnitude: Lower is brighter. -2 is easy from the suburbs, -3 is unmissable, 1 needs a dark site. Brightness is an estimate.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. A pass with no forecast yet is never skipped.
data_description.sky_limit: Used by alerts and the dashboard card. The pass list and calendar never drop a pass for weather.
data_description.people: Each person gets their own pass entities, following the location their Home Assistant app reports.
data_description.update_interval: How often the live position entities update. Pass start and end are always exact to the second.

error.no_quality: Choose at least one pass quality.
error.no_period: Choose evening passes, morning passes, or both.

options.excellent: Excellent: 61-90°, high, bright, hard to miss
options.fair: Fair: 21-40°, visible if you know where to look

stale_tle.title: ISS Track orbital data is out of date
stale_tle.description: ISS Track has not been able to fetch fresh orbital data from Celestrak for more than three days. The map and pass predictions drift further from reality the longer this lasts. Check that Home Assistant can reach celestrak.org; the data refreshes by itself once it can.
